items.title: Physical Natural Gas Buyers Tap Brakes Despite Heat Waves
items.summary: Spot prices for natural gas delivered over the weekend and Monday took a breather following a run of heavy buying in the South earlier in the week to accommodate steamy conditions and strong cooling demand.

items.title: Natural Gas Turbine Demand Surges as Data Centers Drive Power Growth
items.summary: Demand continues to be robust for natural gas turbines, according to executives at the companies manufacturing the power industry’s equipment.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Press Forward as Healthy Supply, Robust Cooling Demand Collide
items.summary: Natural gas futures forged upward on Friday as traders took note of lofty temperatures and strong cooling demand that could exceed stout supply in the week ahead.

items.title: Devon Warns Permian Natural Gas Volatility Could Shift to Gulf Coast
items.summary: Permian Basin natural gas price volatility is likely to outlast the basin’s pipeline buildout, according to Devon Energy, with executives warning the next dislocations could emerge at Gulf Coast hubs as LNG exports outrun storage additions.

items.title: Bullish Forecast Trends Pushing Natural Gas Higher Ahead of Weekend
items.summary: Prompt month natural gas futures appeared to be headed for their first weekly gain since June 18, bolstered by record heat building in the forecast.

items.title: Alaska LNG Bill Again Fails to Gain Traction, Hindering Project’s Path Forward
items.summary: The Alaska legislature has again failed to advance a bill to provide tax exemptions for the massive pipeline that would feed Glenfarne Group’s proposed 20 Mt/y Alaska LNG project.

items.title: Higher Natural Gas Prices Ahead? Efficiency Gains Could Change the Equation
items.summary: US natural gas prices could climb substantially later this decade as LNG exports and power demand increase, though the price needed to bring on sufficient supply is increasingly up for debate.

items.title: Mexico Pulls More US Natural Gas as Texas Storage Levels Drop
items.summary: Mexico has had a strong summer of imports of US natural gas, with demand growing as the Energía Costa Azul (ECA) LNG export terminal in Baja California moves toward commercial operations.
